# Bailey Electrical

> Bailey Electrical is a local, independent, NICEIC registered electrician based in Cardiff, Wales. It specialises in house rewires, consumer unit (fuse box) upgrades, electrics for extensions, kitchens, bathrooms and renovations, and indoor and outdoor lighting. It also carries out EICRs and landlord electrical certificates. It works with homeowners, landlords and letting agents, builders and other trades, and small local businesses.

## Key facts
- Business name: Bailey Electrical
- Type: Domestic electrician / electrical contractor
- Registration: NICEIC registered; full public liability insurance
- Based in: Cardiff, Wales, UK
- Areas covered: Cardiff (Canton, Pontcanna, Llandaff, Whitchurch, Rhiwbina, Heath, Cyncoed, Roath, Penylan, Llanishen, Lisvane, Pontprennau, Radyr, Danescourt, Fairwater, Ely, Grangetown, Cardiff Bay) and roughly 20 miles around, including Penarth, Dinas Powys, Barry, Sully, Vale of Glamorgan, Cowbridge, Llantrisant, Pontyclun, Pontypridd, Caerphilly, Newport. Travels further for larger projects.

## Services
- [House rewires in Cardiff](https://bailey-electrical.co.uk/rewires-cardiff/): Full and partial rewires for homes across Cardiff and the surrounding area — planned properly, finished tidily and certified on completion.
- [Consumer unit & fuse box upgrades in Cardiff](https://bailey-electrical.co.uk/consumer-unit-upgrades-cardiff/): Replace an old fuse box with a modern consumer unit that protects your family and meets current wiring regulations.
- [Electrics for extensions, kitchens & renovations](https://bailey-electrical.co.uk/extensions-renovations-electrician-cardiff/): Complete electrical work for extensions, kitchens, bathrooms and refurbishments across Cardiff — working directly for you or as part of your builder’s team.
- [EICRs & landlord electrical certificates in Cardiff](https://bailey-electrical.co.uk/eicr-landlord-certificates-cardiff/): Electrical Installation Condition Reports for landlords, letting agents, homebuyers and homeowners — with clear explanations and any remedial work done properly.
- [Electrician for builders & trades in Cardiff](https://bailey-electrical.co.uk/builders-trades/): An electrician you can put on your jobs. We work with builders, kitchen and bathroom fitters, carpenters and other trades across Cardiff. We turn up when we say, work around your programme, and leave the paperwork sorted.
- Lighting: downlights, LED upgrades, under-cabinet, plinth and mirror lighting, garden, patio and outdoor lighting
- Also: fault finding and repairs, new circuits and additional sockets, small commercial work by arrangement

## Frequently asked questions
### What areas does Bailey Electrical cover?
We're based in Cardiff and cover the city and roughly 20 miles around it, including Penarth, Barry, the Vale of Glamorgan, Cowbridge, Llantrisant, Pontypridd, Caerphilly and Newport. For larger projects such as rewires, extensions and renovations we're happy to travel further.

### What kind of electrical work do you specialise in?
Full and partial rewires, consumer unit upgrades, electrics for extensions, kitchens, bathrooms and renovations, and indoor and outdoor lighting. We also carry out EICRs, landlord electrical certificates and fault finding.

### Do you work with builders and other trades?
Yes. A lot of our work is alongside builders, kitchen and bathroom fitters and carpenters. We fit first and second fix around the build programme and handle the certification and Building Regulations notification.

### Are you registered and insured?
Yes. Bailey Electrical is NICEIC registered and carries full public liability insurance. Every installation is tested and certified on completion.

### Do you offer free quotes?
Yes. For most jobs we'll visit, agree a clear scope of work and give you a written quote before anything starts, so you know exactly what's included.

### Do you do 24/7 emergency call-outs?
We concentrate on planned work rather than a 24/7 emergency service, which means we can give every job proper time and turn up when we say we will. If you have an electrical problem, call us and we'll help where we can.

### Do you do landlord electrical certificates in Wales?
Yes. We carry out Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICRs) for landlords and letting agents across Cardiff, which landlords in Wales need at least every five years under the Renting Homes (Wales) rules, and we can carry out any remedial work needed.
